If the quote is above your budget we can shorten the trip, choose a lower hotel tier or move to cheaper dates. Tell us which matters most and we will price it.
Three package options for a budget

Three options of {set:company} for {col:enquiries.contact}, dated {today}. Trip: {col:enquiries.trip_type} to {col:enquiries.destination} for {col:enquiries.travellers} travellers. Your budget: {col:enquiries.budget}.
Lower option: a total of about {col:enquiries.opt_low}. Simpler hotels or a shorter stay, the same destination.
Middle option: a total of about {col:enquiries.budget}. Our best match for what you told us.
Higher option: a total of about {col:enquiries.opt_high}. Better rooms, more included and more private services.
Each option is a starting point. We can mix them. Reply with the one that feels closest and we will build a full quote.

{col:briefs.travellers} travellers, {col:briefs.nights} nights, travelling between {col:briefs.window_start} and {col:briefs.window_end} ({col:briefs.window_days} days of choice).

Please check every line. Your signature approves the brief as the basis of the quote.
Terms of {set:company} for quote {col:quotes.quote_id}, dated {today}. Client: {col:quotes.client}.
Validity: this quote is valid until {col:quotes.valid_until}. After that date prices and availability may change.
Price changes: supplier prices can change before full payment. We tell you at once and you may accept the change or cancel.

Payments: the deposit secures the price. The balance due before travel must reach us by the final payment date on your booking confirmation. Our service fee of {col:quotes.service_fee} is shown as its own line and is not refunded if you cancel.
Travel documents: you are responsible for valid travel documents. Check the destination current rules before you book and before you travel. We advise travel insurance for every traveller.
Your signature accepts these terms for this quote.
Dear {col:quotes.client}, our quote {col:quotes.quote_id} for your trip to {col:quotes.destination} is valid until {col:quotes.valid_until}, which is {col:quotes.days_to_expiry} days from today.
The total is {col:quotes.total_quote} for {col:quotes.travellers} travellers. After the expiry date the price and the availability may change.
If you have questions or want changes, please tell us. We can ask the suppliers to extend the price once if you need more time.
Dear {col:partners.contact}, thank you for the clients you send us. So far you have sent {col:partners.leads} enquiries and {col:partners.bookings} became trips, with a value of {col:partners.value}.
Your last thank-you from us was on {col:partners.thank_you_date}. We report back on every trip you send and we are glad to help your own clients and customers.
We would be glad to meet and share ideas for the coming season.
Service fee agreement for a trip
Service fee agreement of {set:company}, dated {today}. Quote {col:quotes.quote_id}, client {col:quotes.client}.
Our service fee for planning and booking your {col:quotes.trip_type} trip to {col:quotes.destination} is {col:quotes.service_fee}, before any tax.
The fee covers planning, quotes, booking, document checks and support until you travel. Suppliers may also pay us a commission. That commission does not change the price you pay.
A change after booking can carry a change fee. We quote it before we act. The service fee is not refunded if you cancel.

Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: mark-up, planning fee, smallest fee, target margin, reply hours, days a quote stays valid and the budget that needs the owner.
Check Team, Clients, Trips and Suppliers. They hold the people, clients, trips and suppliers that every other sheet looks up.
Fill Service Fee Schedule with your own services and fees, and mark the ones you waive for repeat clients.
Fill Destination Price Guide with hotel, daily spend and air fare for the places you sell most, in peak and low season.
Log each enquiry on Enquiries, each first call on Discovery Calls and each brief on Trip Briefs. Replies, follow-ups and budget per person are checked for you.
Write each quote on Quotes and its components on Quote Lines. Margin, margin on net, expiry and chase checks fill in.
Keep Trip Packages and Quote Terms Library as your standard offers and standard clauses.
Record every touch on Follow-up Log and every lost enquiry on Lost Enquiries so the reasons teach you something.
Track Marketing Results and Referral Partners to see which source and which partner bring trips that pay.
Watch Advisor Capacity Weeks before you promise a quote date, and Seasonal Demand and Pipeline by Month for the yearly picture.
Use the 14 calculators for quotes, margins, fees, budgets, payment plans, win chance, counter-offers, add-ons, expiry dates and what-ifs.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Sales Dashboard and Charts every week: enquiries, quotes, bookings, sources, lost reasons, margin and free hours.

Bookings with deposits, final payments and balance owed
One row per supplier booking: confirmation, dates, price, commission rate, deposit and final payment; net to supplier, balance owed and the deadline checks fill in by themselves.
Trips with bookings, balance owed and next deadline
One row per trip: client, type, destination, dates, advisor and price; bookings, what the client has paid, the balance owed, the next final payment and a trip check fill in by themselves.
Client payments with who received the money
One row per payment from a client: booking, kind, who received it, amount, date and method; the part held by the agency, the supplier and the balance left on the trip fill in by themselves.
One row per payment the agency owes a supplier: booking, kind, amount, due date and paid on; the days late, the payment check and the supplier phone fill in by themselves.
Payment schedule of every deposit and final payment
One row per payment step of a booking: deposit or final payment, due date, amount and paid on; the days to the due date, the step check and the client phone fill in by themselves.
Final payment watch with reminders and risk
One row per final payment to watch: due date, reminders sent, last reminder and stage; the client, amount, days to the deadline and the risk level fill in by themselves.
One row per deposit to watch: deposit due date and reminders sent; the client, amount, paid on, days overdue and the deposit check fill in by themselves.
Price holds and option dates with days left
One row per price hold or option date a supplier gives you: trip, supplier, what is held, hold until and status; the client, days left and the hold check fill in by themselves.
Booking changes with price effect and fee
One row per change to a booking: date, kind, who asked, price effect and fee; the client, supplier, commission change, total effect and the price check fill in by themselves.
Cancellations with penalty, refund and fee kept
One row per cancelled booking: date, reason, supplier penalty, client refund and fee kept; the client, what was paid, the net result and the result check fill in by themselves.
Refunds owed to clients and by suppliers
One row per refund: who pays whom, amount, due date and paid on; the trip, client, supplier, days to the refund and the refund check fill in by themselves.
Suppliers with collect mode, terms and bookings
One row per supplier: category, who collects, deposit rate, final payment days and commission terms; the bookings, sales, amount owed and commission expected fill in by themselves.
Clients with trips and open balance
One row per client: kind, phone, country and stage; the number of trips, the balance still owed and the balance check fill in by themselves.
Ticketing deadlines for air, rail and ferry bookings
One row per booking that needs tickets: ticket by date, fare rule and tickets issued on; the supplier, client, days left and the ticketing check fill in by themselves.
Supplier cancellation rules by days before travel
Three stages for each of eight main suppliers: days before travel, penalty share and note; the refundable share and the penalty on an average booking fill in by themselves.
Supplier statements checked against your records
One row per supplier and month: the total the supplier states; the bookings, what is due and paid in your records, the balance and the difference fill in by themselves.
Payment method fees by kind of payment
Twelve rows: each way a client pays and each kind of payment, with the fee rate it costs you; the payments, the amount paid and the fee cost fill in by themselves.
Advisors and specialists with open deadlines
The owner advisor, four advisors and seven freelance specialists with hours and phone; the bookings, final payments due, overdue payments and balance owed of each advisor fill in by themselves.
Bookings, deposits, final payments and cash held by month
One row per month for the last 14 months; bookings, sales, deposits and final payments received, the average booking and the cash held for suppliers all count themselves from the other sheets.
Cash due in the next 60 days with running total
One row per payment expected in or out over the next 60 days: date, direction, party and amount; the signed cash flow, the running total and the days to go fill in by themselves.
